take: The Flyers announced they assigned center Jack Studnicka to Lehigh Valley, placed defenseman Cam York on injured reserve and recalled defenseman Hunter McDonald from the AHL club. York had averaged 21:49 a night, and in the five games since he went out, Nick Seeler has stepped in beside Drysdale (up to 21:58 from 17:50) while Travis Sanheim rose to 26:32 from 24:11. Philadelphia is 2-6-3 and has generated only 39.6% of the expected goals, a measure of chance quality, so McDonald arrives with just one game this season behind him.
